indi_v5_smile.expr: Her small soft mouth a gentle closed smile, warm and shy.

indi_v5_talk.expr: Her small soft mouth gently open mid-word as if speaking softly — NO teeth showing, just a soft open mouth.

indi_v5_peek.expr: Shy PEEK from behind a wet black rock: only the upper head, the eyes and one ocellus visible, one long arm curled softly over the top of her head, mouth a tiny shy closed line.
